Scene:
凉山很大的山，这也找植物。一天，他找到黄色的花。他听说你跟黄色的花做茶很有用。比方说，你的头发疼死，这冰茶是药。他一喝茶就很不舒服。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他听说你跟黄色的花做茶很有用：delete你，用……

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 跟黄色的花做茶：用黄色的花做的茶，Use 用 to introduce the material used to make something; 跟 does not mark the material here. The added 的 connects the action of making the tea to the tea that is useful. [rule: none]
Run 2: 你跟黄色的花做茶：用黄色的花做的茶，Use “用” to introduce the material used to make something; “跟” links people or things together and does not express “using.” The phrase ending in “的” modifies “茶.” [rule: none]

output.reason: Run 1 only corrects 跟 to 用, while Run 2 also removes the erroneous 你, so they do not address the same full error.
